title: Operating Agents Lab
description: Lab 9 of an AI Engineering curriculum: an LLM agent instrumented with OpenTelemetry traces and metrics using the GenAI semantic conventions; retries with jitter and Retry-After, a circuit breaker, a fallback model and a labelled degraded mode; per-request and per-tenant budgets; multi-window burn-rate SLO alerts and spend alerts, rendered as Prometheus rules from the same definitions; idempotent, locked, deadline-bound scheduled agents; runbooks; and a simulated-clock game day that checks exactly which alerts fire under injected faults.
